title: Nexgen OS module manifest, version 1
description: What a module of Nexgen OS says about itself. One file, `modules/<code>/module.json`, read by `nexgen-os init` to find the modules a release ships and by the tests that pin it to the row the module's first migration writes into `nexgen.modules`. Everything a module does is in its migrations and its code; this says what it is, where it lives and what it needs.

code.description: The module's identifier, the name of its folder and the key of `nexgen.modules`. Immutable once published: a module whose name becomes more precise renames its folder and its schema and keeps its code (decision 0033).

description.description: The one thing the module names (decision 0041), as `nexgen.modules.description` holds it.

version.description: The module's version, as `nexgen.modules.version` holds it.

schema.description: The Postgres schema the module lives in. One schema per module, never `nexgen` nor `public` (decision 0032), and PostgREST serves it only once it is listed in the project's exposed schemas.

core.description: The oldest schema version of the core the module runs on, as `nexgen.modules.requires_core_min` holds it.

modules.description: The codes of the modules that must be installed before this one. Empty for a module that starts from the core alone, which is the rule: a module table never names a table of another module.

licence.description: The SPDX identifier of the module's licence: the modules are AGPL-3.0-only, like the core (decision 0005).
